name: Context7 MCP
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C10; partly meets C1; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @upstash/context7-mcp@4.7.0 names the repository `git+https://github.com/upstash/context7.git`. The record carries no provenance attestation (`dist.attestations` is absent).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 4.7.0 is dated 2026-11-12; the newest commit on `master` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The two documented tools look up library documentation; no write or execute tool is documented. Quoted: “`query-docs`: Retrieves documentation for a library using a Context7-compatible library ID.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The API key is passed in an Authorization header set in the client configuration, or obtained through an OAuth setup command. Quoted: “pass your API key via the `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` header”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection, and the documented function contacts only the service the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`pnpm-lock.yaml`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial; `SECURITY.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.1. Lower-bound version 2.3.1 of @modelcontextprotocol/server (npm) was published on 2026-10-05, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
